question:
Simplify the following expression.

 ((256)⁴ times (125)³ times (81)⁵)/((64)⁵ times (25)⁴ times (27)⁶)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert bases: 256=2⁸, 64=2⁶; 125=5³, 25=5²; 81=3⁴, 27=3³

Combine powers ⇒ 2³²/2³⁰=2², 5⁹/5⁸=5, 3²⁰/3¹⁸=3²

Multiply ⇒ 2² × 5 × 3² = 4 × 5 × 9

= 180

**∴ Answer = 180**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(256)⁴ × (125)³ × (81)⁵ ÷ [(64)⁵ × (25)⁴ × (27)⁶]

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule and laws of exponents

**Calculation:**

⇒ = (2⁸)⁴ × (5³)³ × (3⁴)⁵ ÷ [(2⁶)⁵ × (5²)⁴ × (3³)⁶]

⇒ = 2³² × 5⁹ × 3²⁰ ÷ [2³⁰ × 5⁸ × 3¹⁸]

⇒ = 2⁽³²−³⁰⁾ × 5⁽⁹−⁸⁾ × 3⁽²⁰−¹⁸⁾

⇒ = 2² × 5 × 3²

⇒ = 4 × 5 × 9

⇒ = 180

**∴ The correct answer is 180.**
